content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I have a question: Is it possible to display real-time I/O status overview values that aren't included in the appended text message? For instance, I would like to visualize the output from a temperature measurement block and see its variations in real time. Is that achievable? Thanks!
Where do you want to see these values? On a PC or another device?
On a PC. Ideally, I'd like to see the values in software like Excel. Currently, it seems I can only monitor standard types like text messages, input, analog input, and output in real time.

Are you familiar with the [product_name] Access Tool? However, it may not be compatible with the latest Excel versions. There's more info and downloads available on the [company_name] website: [product_name] Access Tool. Additionally, you might want to check out topics about Office add-ins for the recent Office versions.
I wasn't aware of the [product_name] Access Tool. I'll look into it. Thanks a lot!

analysis.insight_summary: A user inquired about dynamically displaying real-time I/O output data, such as temperature block measurements, on a PC using customizable formats like Excel. Another participant mentioned a specific tool that allows exporting such data to Excel, though compatibility issues with newer Excel versions remain. The exchange reveals limited awareness of available integration solutions and concerns about software version compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to monitor real-time outputs from a particular function block on their PC in a customizable interface like Excel, beyond the basic I/O status overview.
